claims.text: PCN-susceptible strep, NVE: PCN G 4 wk, or 2 wk if given w gentamicin.
claims.quote: For NVE: Penicillin G 12–18 million units a day IV continuously or 2–3 million units every 4 hours for 4 weeks or, if gentamicin 3 mg/kg† IV or IM once a day is given concurrently, for 2 weeks
claims.locator: Some Antibiotic Regimens for Endocarditis in the United States (table) › Streptococci susceptible to penicillin

claims.text: PVE: PCN G 6 wk, or 2 wk if given w gentamicin.
claims.quote: For PVE: Penicillin G 24 million units a day IV continuously or 4 million units every 4 hours for 6 weeks or, if gentamicin 3 mg/kg† IV or IM (up to 80 mg) is given concurrently, for 2 weeks
claims.locator: Some Antibiotic Regimens for Endocarditis in the United States (table) › Streptococci susceptible to penicillin
